_about: Sir William Woodthorpe Tarn (1869-1957), historian of the Hellenistic world. Books published before 1930 (US public domain by date); his novel from Gutenberg.

tarn-treasure-isle-of-mist-pg: The Treasure of the Isle of Mist (1919), a children's novel

_rights_checked.tarn-antigonos-gonatas-1913: Title verso read: 'First published 1913. Reprinted lithographically ... 1969'. A photographic reprint of the 1913 text, no new matter; US PD by the 1913 publication.
_rights_checked.tarn-hellenistic-civilisation-1927: Title page read: London, Edward Arnold, 1927 (first edition). The preface's date OCRs as 'August 1937', almost certainly a misread of the first edition's date; the title page governs.
